data.name: Bethena
data.gender_notes: Bethena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Bethys, meaning 'house of God'. In the New Testament, Bethany is the name of a village where Jesus visited and healed the sister of Lazarus. The name Bethena carries the meaning “House of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bethena usually hope their child will grow to embody house of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes devotion and faith.
data.etymology: Bethena belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “House of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bethena total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: בֵּתֶנָה
in_hebrew.meaning: בֵּית לַעֲנָה - בית של עניה או בית דל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ביתנה מורכב משתי מילים עבריות: בית ועניה. הוא מתייחס לבית או מקום של ענייה או דלת, ויכול גם להיות קשור למילה עברית אחרת שפירושה בית של תענוג או שמחה. השם מופיע בתנ"ך כמקום או שם של נשים, ויש לו קונוטציות של צניעות ודלות.

in_greek.name: Βεθηνά
in_greek.meaning: Βεθηνά - Παράγωγο της Βέθη, σπίτι της θλίψης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βεθηνά είναι πιθανότατα παράγωγο της ελληνικής λέξης Βέθη, που σημαίνει σπίτι της θλίψης ή του πόνου. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα αυτό, αλλά οι ελληνικές ρίζες του υποδεικνύουν σύνδεση με έννοιες θρησκευτικές και πνευματικές.

in_latin.name: Bethena
in_latin.meaning: Bethena - Domo pauperis or Domus laetitiae
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bethena derivatur ex hebraeo, significans domum pauperis vel domo laetitiae. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc habet connotationes humilitatis et devotionis, referens ad locum vel habitaculum spirituale.

in_english.name: Bethena
in_english.meaning: House of sorrow, affliction, or joy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bethena originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the words 'beth' meaning house and 'anah' meaning sorrow or affliction. It can also be interpreted as 'house of joy' in some contexts. Historically, the name may relate to places or women mentioned in biblical texts, symbolizing humility and spiritual devotion. In Christian tradition, Bethena represents a place of worship or spiritual refuge.
